title: Quantum Property Testing for Bounded-Degree Directed Graphs
summary: We study quantum property testing of directed graphs whose maximum in-degree and out-degree are bounded by a fixed constant $d$. For a proximity parameter $\varepsilon$, we prove that every property testable with $O_{\varepsilon,d}(1)$ quantum queries in the bidirectional model, where both incoming and outgoing neighbors are accessible, can also be tested in the quantum unidirectional model, where only outgoing neighbors are accessible, using $n^{1/2-Ω_{\varepsilon,d}(1)}$ queries. This gives an almost quadratic quantum speedup over the best known generic classical transformation. Our proof…
